dismiss.description: What lets go of a picked card or a chosen stage: any (a second click, Escape, empty space in the visual, or a click anywhere outside it) or no_outside (the same, but a click outside the visual changes nothing).

highlight.description: Cards (ids) and the links between them to keep clear from the first draw, with every other card and link faded, as a dimmed mark is (its words stay readable): a traced path. links left out lights every link between two of the cards; given, exactly those links, and a link with no kind every link of that pair. A hidden card stays hidden. The highlight command overrides it.

select.about: Picks cards (`kind: "card"`, the default when ids are given: `ids` pins those cards and the last is the lead, unless `id` among them names the lead), or one stage (`kind: "stage"`, `id`). No data, or `kind: "all"`, lets go of everything. Answers true (also when nothing changed), or false (with a console warning) for an id it has not got.

ids.about: The cards to keep clear; one id alone is a list of one.

links.about: Rows of `from`, `to` and, if wanted, `kind` (one row alone is a list of one): exactly the links to keep clear.

highlight.about: Keeps the cards in `ids` and the links between two of them clear and fades every other card and link, as a dimmed mark is (its words stay readable): a traced path. `links` (rows of `from`, `to` and, if wanted, `kind`) lights exactly those links instead; a link with no `kind` lights every link of that pair. A highlighted link of a quiet kind shows; a hidden card stays hidden. While a highlight names cards it decides the fading: a card picked with `select` keeps its ring and details and stays clear. No data, or no `ids`, lets go (of the `highlight` option too). Fires no event. Answers true (also when nothing changed), or false (with a console warning, changing nothing) for an id it has not got, a link naming a card not in `ids`, or a link the data does not have.

hosted.about: Says which regions of the map the page hosts elsewhere: a list of `title`, `details`, `stage`, `steps`, `zones` (one name as text is read as a list of one); `null` is none. Answers true, or false for a region it does not know, changing nothing.

size.about: Gives back `{ needs, stack_below }`, the width in pixels the map needs and the width below which it stacks; from kit 0.37.0 until a later release also `stacksBelow`, the old name of `stack_below` (sent until a later release).

history.about: Gives back an answer record (a `list` visual with one row per step) for a host to show in a pop-up.

show.about: Shows the card with that id again after a hide. Answers true, also when nothing changed, or false (with a console warning) for an id it has not got.

hide.about: Hides the card with that id (and anything under it) until `show`. Answers true, also when nothing changed, or false (with a console warning) for an id it has not got.

disable.about: Greys out the card with that id and shows the reader the reason. Answers true, also when nothing changed, or false for an id it has not got or a `reason` that is blank.

enable.about: Takes a `disable` away from the card with that id. Answers true, also when nothing changed, or false for an id it has not got.

state.about: Gives back what the part shows now: `selected` (the lead card's id, else null), `selected_ids` (every card picked, the lead last), `stage` (the stage chosen, else null), `step` (the player's index, -1 at Start or without a player), `highlighted` (`{ ids, links }`, the highlight as given, links as `{ from, to, kind }`; empty lists when none), `hidden` and `disabled` (lists of ids), and `host_changes`: one row per id the host changed, `{ id, hidden, disabled, reason, badge, badge_set }`.

kind.about: What changed selection: "card", "stage", or "all" (when both a card and a stage were let go together).

id.about: The lead card's or chosen stage's id; null when let go.

ids.about: List of picked card ids with the lead last, or the chosen stage's id in a one-item list; empty when let go.

from.about: The id that was picked before this change; null when none was picked.

label.about: The lead card's or chosen stage's title; null when let go.

details.about: The card's or stage's details record for a host panel; null when let go.

still.about: When one kind was let go while the other stays picked, { kind, id, ids, details } for what stays picked; null otherwise.

by.about: Who changed the selection: "reader", "host" (a command), or "data" (new data or options).

via.about: How it happened (kit 0.37.0): "click" (pointer, touch or a click away), "key" (Enter, Space, Escape or a screen reader's press), "command" (the host's select, hide or disable), or null for new data. Kind "all" takes the first change's. Only when the page's trail is on.

at.about: When it happened, stamped by the kit. Only when the page's trail is on.

seq.about: Its place in the page's order of events, stamped by the kit. Only when the page's trail is on.

part.about: The part's name, stamped by the kit on every event.

name.about: The row's name, stamped by the kit on every event (null when the part has none).

needs.about: Width in pixels the map needs to draw without scrolling.

stack_below.about: Width in pixels below which the grid stacks stage by stage (500); null for levels and dates layouts, which never stack. Same name as columns' option.

stacksBelow.about: The old name of stack_below, with the same value: sent from kit 0.37.0 until a later release. Readers fall back to it for copies made before 0.37.0.

at.about: When it happened, stamped by the kit. Only when the page's trail is on.

seq.about: Its place in the page's order of events, stamped by the kit. Only when the page's trail is on.

part.about: The part's name, stamped by the kit on every event.

name.about: The row's name, stamped by the kit on every event (null when the part has none).

kind.about: What kind of mark the pointer rests on: "card" or "stage".

id.about: The id of the card or stage; null when the pointer left it.

at.about: When it happened, stamped by the kit. Only when the page's trail is on.

seq.about: Its place in the page's order of events, stamped by the kit. Only when the page's trail is on.

part.about: The part's name, stamped by the kit on every event.

name.about: The row's name, stamped by the kit on every event (null when the part has none).

href.about: The address of the link the reader clicked.

field.about: Which text of the entry the link was in; null when not given.

id.about: The id of the row the link belongs to; null when not given.

tokens.--stagemap-stage-map-target: The target card's outline (default: the page's accent).
tokens.--stagemap-stage-map-card-line: Every card's outline (default: the page's line-strong).
tokens.--stagemap-stage-map-band: The stage bands (default: the page's panel-soft).
tokens.--stagemap-stage-map-selected: The chosen stage (default: the page's accent-soft).
tokens.--stagemap-stage-map-hover: The edge of the card under the pointer or focus (default: the page's accent).
tokens.--stagemap-stage-map-disabled: A disabled card's edge, dimmed (default: the page's muted).
